description: The first TDD tranche covers the singleton-state defect. Later tranches must expand this manifest to the complete ledger in 27-02-RECONSTRUCTION-PLAN.md before any candidate can pass Phase 27.

guards.clause: The browser binding cookie carries the Secure attribute.
guards.focusedTest: independent browsers sharing one login session create separate immutable file intents

guards.clause: Preflight probing is bounded across browser-binding rotation for one authenticated actor and action.
guards.focusedTest: preflight withholds descriptors by capability and rate-limits authorized probing

guards.clause: Failed approval attempts share one account-scoped budget across intents, browser bindings, and both the file-write and package-upload approval endpoints.
guards.focusedTest: approval throttling survives intent and binding rotation and exposes victim lockout

guards.clause: Each successful preflight creates a fresh opaque intent ID.
guards.focusedTest: independent browsers sharing one login session create separate immutable file intents

guards.clause: A successful preflight inserts a new record and never overwrites another browser's intent.
guards.focusedTest: independent browsers sharing one login session create separate immutable file intents

guards.clause: Approval selects the exact intent named in the request and never falls back to global state.
guards.focusedTest: independent browsers sharing one login session create separate immutable file intents

guards.clause: Redemption selects the exact submitted intent and never falls back to global state.
guards.focusedTest: independent browsers sharing one login session create separate immutable file intents

guards.clause: The upload effect accepts a real multipart request rather than treating the envelope as package bytes. WEAK KILL: the probe runs before approval, so the mutant falls past the body parse into the binding disjunct and dies at 403 rather than the 400 the clause describes. It discriminates two rejection codes and never an accepted effect. Moving the probe after approval would consume the one-use intent, so strengthening it needs the test restructured.
guards.focusedTest: browser-bound package approval sends bytes once and rejects clone, mutation, and replay

guards.clause: The upload effect accepts exactly one package part. WEAK KILL: same mediation as UPLOAD_MULTIPART — the duplicate-part probe also runs before approval, so the mutant dies at 403 from the binding disjunct rather than at the 400 the clause describes.
guards.focusedTest: browser-bound package approval sends bytes once and rejects clone, mutation, and replay

guards.clause: The upload effect hashes the decoded package bytes and rejects post-approval substitution.
guards.focusedTest: browser-bound package approval sends bytes once and rejects clone, mutation, and replay

guards.clause: An unauthorized preflight returns an equivalent status, body, and cache contract without resolving the requested target.
guards.focusedTest: preflight failures do not reveal target validity or resolve a target before authorization

guards.clause: A declared upload body larger than the cap is rejected before body bytes are read. Without the guard the stream cap still returns 413, so the distinguishing observation is the byte-count evidence, not the status.
guards.focusedTest: upload body limits reject declared length before reading and stop chunked input at cap plus one byte

guards.clause: A chunked upload stops at the cap plus one byte and rejects the body.
guards.focusedTest: upload body limits reject declared length before reading and stop chunked input at cap plus one byte

guards.clause: Approving a file-write intent requires a live login session, independently of the browser binding and of the intent record. The probe holds the binding and the intent the server itself issued to it and downgrades only wp_auth, so the three disjuncts sharing that `if` cannot stand in for the kill; it sends the CORRECT factor, because authorizeApprovalFactor runs immediately afterwards and a wrong password would return the same 403 under mutation. Ledger clause APPROVE_AUTH in 27-02-RECONSTRUCTION-PLAN.md.
guards.focusedTest: a downgraded login session cannot approve or redeem its own correctly bound intent

guards.clause: Redeeming an approved file-write intent requires a live login session. The submission carries the exact target and digest and an unused intent, so neither the one-use 409 nor the descriptor-mismatch 409 can stand in for the 403. Ledger clause EFFECT_AUTH in 27-02-RECONSTRUCTION-PLAN.md. SCOPE: the same login-session disjunct on the two UPLOAD-lane endpoints (/candidate-upload-approve, /candidate-upload-effect) is still unguarded and unmutated — closing it needs UPLOAD_APPROVE_AUTH / UPLOAD_EFFECT_AUTH and a multipart fixture, and is recorded as open in 27-04-EXIT-WORK-HANDOFF.md.
guards.focusedTest: a downgraded login session cannot approve or redeem its own correctly bound intent
